When one moves fast and breaks things, the wisdom of Sam Altman comes to mind. First 11 minutes of this were exceptionally relevant to my recent "startup experience" –

Just so the story is clear, in public:

- Cat & Zach love to put "things in writing." they are self proclaimed as YC-pilled. i approve heavily. for real.

- Cat called me. i was recruited to work at Simple AI. i never applied to any job posting. see below emails & legal docs.

- it is better to figure out misalignment in the first month than in the 9th . trust me.

- I remain bullish on Simple and deeply respect Cat & Zach as operators and ICs. Whoever ends up working with them, as teammates or customers, you can expect nothing but the very best! i will provide a reference at any time. call me. salt and water dissolve over time, for me quite quickly.
